# aitana

> Validation and benchmarking framework for AI/ML in volcano monitoring.

## Docs

### API Reference

#### aitana.access
> Pure I/O access layer for volcano monitoring data (GeoNet TILDE, WFS, seismic waveforms).

- [access.tilde.tilde_request](https://tsc-tools.github.io/aitana/reference/access.tilde.tilde_request.html)
- [access.wfs.wfs_request](https://tsc-tools.github.io/aitana/reference/access.wfs.wfs_request.html)
- [access.seismic.SeismicData](https://tsc-tools.github.io/aitana/reference/access.seismic.SeismicData.html)
- [access.seismic.WaveformBaseclass](https://tsc-tools.github.io/aitana/reference/access.seismic.WaveformBaseclass.html)
- [access.seismic.SDSWaveforms](https://tsc-tools.github.io/aitana/reference/access.seismic.SDSWaveforms.html)
- [access.seismic.FDSNWaveforms](https://tsc-tools.github.io/aitana/reference/access.seismic.FDSNWaveforms.html)
- [access.seismic.S3Waveforms](https://tsc-tools.github.io/aitana/reference/access.seismic.S3Waveforms.html)
- [access.seismic.MockSDSWaveforms](https://tsc-tools.github.io/aitana/reference/access.seismic.MockSDSWaveforms.html)

- [access.api.AitanaAPI](https://tsc-tools.github.io/aitana/reference/access.api.AitanaAPI.html)
- [access.util.get_defaults_with_names](https://tsc-tools.github.io/aitana/reference/access.util.get_defaults_with_names.html)

#### aitana.volcanoes

#### aitana.testing
> Synthetic seismic waveforms with known spectral content for testing aitana packages.

- [testing.synthetic.synthetic_trace](https://tsc-tools.github.io/aitana/reference/testing.synthetic.synthetic_trace.html)
